summary: Smart-money structure: BoS and ChoCh, inducement, order blocks, FVGs, MTF structure, SMT against a paired symbol and dashboards.
overview: This community script maps market structure with smart-money labels. It marks breaks of structure (BoS), changes of character (ChoCh), inducement (IDM), sweeps, external and inducement order blocks, and FVGs inside order blocks. It can also show multi-timeframe structure, inner structure, Fibonacci levels and trend dots, and color the background by structure.
A second part, Smart Point, adds velocity and SMC bar signals, entry labels from order blocks, target and stop boxes, a performance dashboard and an MTF trend dashboard.
how: External structure uses a swing length of 5; the multi-timeframe and inner structures use 3 and 2. IDM can follow external inducement or the last valid pullback. Order blocks come from the extreme candle of each leg, with up to 20 kept per type.
SMT looks for Smart Money Traps against a correlated symbol: you can set one, or leave it empty for automatic pairs such as BTC/ETH, XAU/XAG, EUR/GBP, AUD/NZD and USD pairs against DXY.
Smart Point signals can be gated by order blocks and an optional liquidity sweep, with a set risk-to-reward ratio for the boxes.
use: Use the BoS and ChoCh labels to follow the current trend leg.
Some traders watch the inducement level as the point price may sweep before an order block is reached.
Use the MTF dashboard to compare trend direction across timeframes.
Use the performance dashboard to review past Smart Point signals under its rules.
alerts: Alerts: the script sends its own alert messages, and members can create an alert on them from the chart's alert dialog; alerts from indicators run while ZoroCharts is open in the browser.
notes: Structure can be drawn over the whole history or from a start date.
SMT needs data for the paired symbol.
Inner structure is dense and off by default.
